label: Read the complete materialized arist phys viii 1 witness
summary: Read the complete materialized ARIST-PHYS-VIII-1 witness. The opening alternative at 250b11-15 is an inquiry, not yet a commitment to everlasting motion. The survey at 250b15-23 introduces cosmologists who admit motion and the infinite-world account; extracted only the substantive parenthetical necessity that world generations/destructions occur with motion. Rejected identifying generation itself with motion in the strict sense, and rejected treating the attributed infinite-world cosmology as Aristotle's own endorsement. The one-world survey transition and the Anaxagoras and Empedocles accounts after 250b20 and their interpretation through 251a7 remain unprocessed, alongside the later temporal priority and everlasting-motion arguments. No derivation, root-premise discharge, or chapter completion is claimed.
